brief:
**BLUF:** No major law enforcement, fire, EMS or hazard incidents reported in Tazewell County, VA or immediate core area (Bluefield VA/WV, Mercer County WV) in the last 24 hours. Bluefield, VA held its annual Christmas tree lighting Saturday evening with a “Santa’s Workshop” theme and community activities. Regionally, the White Oak Flat wildfire in Alleghany County, VA (northwest of Clifton Forge) has grown to ~1,000 acres with 0% containment and ongoing suppression efforts; smoke may affect nearby areas.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/21/bluefield-tree-lighting-starts-christmas-season-with-santas-workshop-theme/)[[2]](https://virginianreview.com/344556/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours for Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, local police departments, Mercer County Sheriff or WV State Police (Princeton) in the core area. No arrests, charges, investigations or court outcomes noted from available sources.

In the region: No significant state police, sheriff or federal cases (Western District of VA / Southern District of WV) reported in the last 24 hours.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours for structure fires, serious crashes, rescues or incidents in Tazewell County or core towns.

In the region: No major incidents noted beyond the ongoing Alleghany County wildfire (see Hazards).

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
**Core:** No active NWS alerts. Weather in Tazewell/Bluefield area: cloudy with periods of rain possible Sunday (high near 59°F, low near 50°F); light winds. No flooding, power outages, boil-water notices or VDOT/WVDOH closures reported on US-19, US-460, US-52, Route 16 or I-77.

**Region:** White Oak Flat wildfire (Alleghany County, VA, ~2 miles northwest of Clifton Forge on Fore Mountain in George Washington and Jefferson National Forest) estimated at 1,000 acres, 0% contained as of latest updates. 89 personnel on scene with handcrews, engines, bulldozers and helicopters; no private lands or structures threatened and no evacuations. Closures in effect for Forest Service Road 125 (Dolly Ann Road from Covington to SR-606), FS Roads 337 and 448, and Fore Mountain Trail. Smoke visible from local roads including portions of I-64 and US-60; rain expected Sunday may aid efforts.[[2]](https://virginianreview.com/344556/)[[3]](https://wset.com/news/local/white-oak-flat-wildfire-reaches-800-acres-in-alleghany-county-november-2026)

No other severe weather, large power/water/rail incidents or interstate closures reported on I-77, I-81, I-64, US-460, US-19 or US-23 in the broader region.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours for Tazewell County Board of Supervisors, town councils or school board actions.

In the region: No new state government actions from Richmond, Charleston or other capitals noted impacting the area.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Bluefield, VA hosted its annual Christmas tree lighting Saturday at Jack Asbury Square with “Santa’s Workshop” theme, including free activities, ice skating, refreshments and community participation. Bluefield also promoted local shopping on Pink Friday (Nov 20). A community Thanksgiving service is scheduled for 6 p.m. Sunday at The Vine in Bluefield, WV (1026 Blue Prince Rd), hosted by Greater Princeton Ministerial Association, with a message by Pastor Dan Jividen and canned food donations for Princeton Tender Mercies.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/21/bluefield-tree-lighting-starts-christmas-season-with-santas-workshop-theme/)

In the region: Nothing additional on employers, mines, hospitals or energy projects.

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Bluefield, VA/WV holiday events and community Thanksgiving service (Sunday evening).
- Ongoing White Oak Flat wildfire suppression in Alleghany County, VA; monitor for smoke impacts and road/trail closures.
- Typical late-November weather with possible rain; no severe alerts currently.
